primitive_sources.review: Official kernel documentation distinguishes inode filesystem ownership from per-mount ownership, including stat output. Read-only source review; no Linux code copied. The supported initialized coherent UID-view profile is explicit.

Tracked user.* fsetxattr(XATTR_CREATE) cannot replace an already-present attribute. Actual adapter op20 passes that flag; ACL/security dispatch is outside the tracked-name law. Read-only primary-source review, no Linux code copied.
Deletion permission is checked on directory/entry ownership and sticky/DAC conditions; retirement is not a file-write authorization. No Linux code copied.

review.birth_scope: DirectoryHandles establishes genuine output handles; it does not equate their opened inode to the preceding mkdir birth. That equality remains the global namespace/family invariant responsibility.
review.create_only_attribute: ExistingAttributeContract names exact one-operation XATTR_CREATE semantics for tracked user.* attributes, plus individual SDK/socket/child attribute effects. An already-present tracked tag on an OLD still-live inode cannot be replaced by that primitive, independently of whether its FD appears in the acting raw projection. This is not a whole private-region frame or an attribute law for arbitrary ACL/security names.
review.guard_producer: actual_guard_excludes_initial_marker extracts the exact SourceReturnAt guard Tick from the same full ActorJournal and ExternalJournal. It derives actual per-operation source/DAC restrictions, old-inode liveness and the protected marker at THAT prior guard snapshot, then contradicts its actual ENODATA observation. It does not assume a marker at the guard or that a private path stayed unchanged.
review.initial_boundary: Initial input is the exact allocated logical object with real UID, no group/other write bits, and an existing private marker. It is a precise protected-bootstrap/earlier-source observation, not HostSafe, SnapshotSafe, PublicationSafe or a whole-file immutable-region premise.
review.metadata: LiveMetadataContract frames UID/type/low authority bits only for a still-live object across one actual syscall/SDK/child event. The application proves tracked setter names from actual source. Ordinary foreign authorized changes remain in the relation; key/object owner and mode checks derive denial in the selected case. No file-content, size, timestamps, links or pathname interval is frozen.
review.mount_identity_view: The supported initialized platform profile, explicitly stated in FS-host-boundary.ownership and AR-host-boundary.primitives, has a coherent host UID view across permitted ordinary bind aliases. Idmapped aliases require a later per-mount view model; mount ID/stat bytes alone are not mapping evidence. This is not a private-region/HostSafe assumption. Numeric inode reuse remains distinct.
review.remaining: Global family/capability/birth-to-open/cleanup ownership; complete per-child filesystem footprint; actual public caller freeze-context and bootstrap-key observation producers; full key bytes/nonexposure flow and computational authenticity over the complete key lifetime including persisted reports; compatible useful global execution and integrated M5.2 acceptance.
review.retirement: ObjectAlive describes live lifetime metadata, not numeric device/inode injectivity or knowledge newly learned by fstat. ObjectLifetimeContract supplies individual raw-reference liveness and backward no-resurrection for OLD logical lifetime tokens. A late actual guard therefore derives prior liveness at every relevant journal snapshot. Retired objects and error/lost effects remain broad.
review.setter_custody: selected_attribute_handle derives every actual returned/lost application setter target from the same actor history: either successful actual run newChild opening or publisher fresh stage followed by the real hash/auth/fill program. No raw-handle binding, phase label or whole-helper frame is a premise. The stage/container raw Handle/OFD outputs are derived by actual acknowledged open/stat source and primitive effects.
review.snapshot_consumer: actual_snapshot_protected_reference composes the maintained Snapshot.freeze prefix and actual source-event/context equality with that historical guard producer. It yields a genuine live read handle whose physical object differs from the protected key/object, including a lost read response. The public application producer must supply the actual freeze context from its existing preparation source cuts.

status: Reviewed source-derived setter custody and historical guard/key-object exclusion. Full M5.2 public/physical guarantee remains in progress.

supersedes.reason: Unlinking the final inode binding can retire an object and discard its attributes using parent directory permission, without file CanWrite. The corrected law retains that actual Linux case.
supersedes.rows: ForeignContract.attribute_permission and foreign_cannot_clear_private_attribute now require actual after-object liveness. Their current complete types are sealed here. Prior supporting evidence is unchanged and does not claim this retirement case was already justified.
